assets.prompt: High-quality editorial illustration with tactile gouache and colored-pencil texture, confident charcoal-black outlines of varied weight, simplified sculptural shapes, warm cream background, electric lime accents, pale powder blue planes, off-white paper and warm neutral wood. Contemporary adult educational brand inVision U, thoughtful clean composition, expressive but not childish. Clearly drawn and illustrated, NEVER photographic or photorealistic, no photographic people, no polished stock 3D render, no SVG-flat icon look. Rich hand-made details and slight print grain. No text, lettering, numbers, logo, arrows, flowchart lines, interface overlays or watermark. Landscape 3:2, preserve generous cream margins and keep essential objects fully visible.  Homepage hero scene representing exploration of several educational directions, WITHOUT ANY ROBOT, machine character or human figures. An inviting contemporary learning studio seen from a wide three-quarter angle. A broad pale-blue communal project table in foreground with an open cream sketchbook, three thoughtfully arranged paper studies with abstract unlettered shapes, an electric-lime notebook, a charcoal pencil, a small simple blue camera resting to one side. Background has cream bookshelves, a large warm daylight window, lime and pale-blue chairs around another shared table, a plant. Open doorway connects a second collaborative space, suggesting paths to explore without signs, arrows or a maze. Beautiful tactile hand-drawn gouache illustration, strongly visible pencil line and dry-brush texture, soft geometric color planes, cream and blue light. Keep the composition restrained with breathing room. The workspace as a whole is the subject, not one discipline or a collage of five objects. No people, photographic material or robot anywhere. All furniture and important foreground objects comfortably within frame, no embedded typography. This is an invented educational space, not an actual university building.

assets.prompt: Create a single hand-drawn editorial brand emblem on a transparent background for personal learning progress. Square canvas. Compact sculptural paper shape with clear silhouette, centered, occupies 80% of canvas, no perspective distortion, good legibility at 28 pixels. Style: adult contemporary educational brand, warm cream highlights, electric lime, powder blue and black. Clearly an illustration, not a photograph, not shiny plastic, no realistic hands.
